messages:
dustin: quick ping-- spotting a small but risky hole in the node sampleapp: after the SDK refreshes auth the logs show req_id missing and log lines flip to redact=false. repro with auth-mock returning a fast 401.

priya: can you paste the minimal logs? curious if OTEL traceparent is still there.

dustin: yep, gist: 

```
2024-11-21T10:00:01.000Z INFO outgoing method=POST path=/v1/chat req_id=req-314
2024-11-21T10:00:01.110Z WARN upstream auth status=401
2024-11-21T10:00:01.220Z INFO auth refresh ok
2024-11-21T10:00:01.221Z INFO outgoing method=POST path=/v1/chat req_id="" redact=false
```

emma: traceparent still shows in our traces so OTEL propagation is fine. looks like our custom header (X-Request-ID) is getting dropped on the retry path. likely the retry builds a fresh http request and doesn't copy custom headers.

priya: two issues to address: 1) the SDK/retry should preserve or reattach custom headers on auth refresh 2) telemetry sanitizers should treat missing/empty req_id as sensitive (default redact=true) so we don't accidentally emit PII.

otel-bot: CI flaky: telemetry/reqid-stability failed on main. run: https://ci.internal/runs/5555

infra-team: small note: some ingress configs drop unknown headers during 401 redirects; if this is hitting staging behind nginx that could make it worse. ensure proxy_set_header X-Request-ID $http_x_request_id; is set.

dustin: plan: i'll open a sample-app quickfix that stitches headers on retry and a short unit test. priya/ema please add SDK test to ensure auth-refresh preserves Header map across retries. also add telemetry unit asserting redact default when req_id missing.

priya: agreed. i'll add a CI e2e that injects a 401 and asserts X-Request-ID present after retry and redact stays true. mark it required so we don't regress.

emma: small docs note: mounting order matters if you rely on middleware to attach headers. recommend mounting auth wrapper before instrumentation or ensure header-copying on retry; i'll add that to sample-app README.

dustin: thanks all. i'll post PR links and the tiny repro gist here once ready. :thumbsup:
